word_spacing_rule: FIX for v1 'কীকীআছে?'/'হুকিংকপি'/'ছবিআপলোড': every word is its own inline-block span; when space_after=true render a real U+0020 space AFTER the span (outside it) or margin-right 0.28em (Bangla) / 0.22em (Anton). Lay out the FULL line once at final positions (all words, opacity 0) and only animate opacity/transform per word — never append words to a growing string, never position by measuring a partial line. Use white-space: pre-wrap on the line; no letter-spacing on Bangla.
sfx_rule: v1 SFX were inaudible (gain bug). Every sfx_pops entry must be AUDIBLE: target peak −12…−9 dBFS on the final mix (≈6–9 dB under voice peaks), normalise each file before gain; ticks/pops 60–150 ms. If two pops are <0.12 s apart keep only the accent one. Impacts stay reserved for ডিজাইন 1.067 and আমি (v2 42.133).
